title: Stacked voices
summary: Read and build verbs with several voice suffixes: the fixed order reciprocal or reflexive, causative, passive (*tanıştırıldım*, I was introduced), the causative passive of things had done or commissioned (*Bu cami Kanuni tarafından yaptırıldı*), the double causative (*öldürtmek*), and voices with **can** and **can't** (*yapılamaz*, *yaptırılabilir*).
canDo: Take a long verb apart from the root out and say who does what
Say what was had done or commissioned, and by whom
Read and write notices about what can and can't be done
Follow a visit to a craft workshop and describe how something is made
